title: ULA's Vulcan rocket is set to return to flight on Friday the 13th
gist: ULA plans to return Vulcan to flight on November 13 carrying 40 Amazon Leo satellites, nine months after a February solid rocket booster nozzle failure grounded it. The Space Force, which relies on Vulcan for roughly half its major launches into the early 2030s, has shifted six missions to SpaceX and wants commercial flight data before resuming national security launches.
